notice: Experimental 35mm photographic exercise studies. No photo or video is approved as safe or correct workout instruction.

identity.title: Middle-school photographic boy — visual identity master V2

cards.title: Toe touch + backward stretch
cards.note: Preferred framed start; avoid forced six-inch reach or artificially long arms.

cards.title: Partial sit-up
cards.note: Keep partial range; don't turn into full sit-up.

cards.title: Alternate prone SINGLE-leg raise
cards.note: Clean repaired pose; near/far leg identity verified with markers, not obvious in untagged card.

cards.title: Kneeling push-up
cards.note: Four stages. Check shoulder–hip–knee alignment, near/far hands, soft adolescent anatomy.

cards.title: Scissor jump, arms extended
cards.note: Preferred clean arms-at-shoulder-height card. Shoulder range and pose transition need human review.

variants.title: 19R bent-arm alternative, NOT faithful to exercise

cards.title: Low stationary-run Flow video
cards.note: 6-second render exists, but motion/loop and character identity have not been fully checked.

cards.title: Prone back extension
cards.note: Both legs should lift straight; far leg partially hidden at strict side profile.

cards.title: Astride jump
cards.note: Shoes unpointed; arms at shoulder height, not quite above. No motion test.

cards.title: Full sit-up
cards.note: Nearly upright, feet planted; hands no longer prop up the torso.

cards.title: Standard toe push-up
cards.note: Softer shoulders than earlier 24; palms/toes support, not knees. Motion not verified.

cards.title: Toe-touch downward press
cards.note: Headroom corrected; timing/press cadence cannot be judged from stills alone.

cards.title: Hands-behind-head sit-up
cards.note: Knees still too flexed for strict booklet and right shoe nearly clips frame.

cards.title: Hands-clasped back extension
cards.note: Far leg partly occluded; still image only.

cards.title: Half-knee bends
cards.note: Heels rise, toes stay planted; verify depth and balance.

cards.title: Partial V / forehead push-up
cards.note: Near-touch without forced forehead contact is the promising geometry; deep V elbows in 29E/H/J were hyperextended. Do NOT animate unreviewed.

cards.title: Straight-leg toe-touch sit-up
cards.note: Arms toward feet with slight elbow bend.

cards.title: T-arm back extension
cards.note: Both arms extended sideways; far leg partly obscured.

cards.title: Wide-hand push-up
cards.note: Preferred softer youth shoulders; both palms and elbows visible.

cards.title: Semi-squat jump
cards.note: Feet in air natural; right-foot-leading identity uncertain.

cards.title: High knees / waist-high running
cards.note: Current preferred human-reviewed silhouette: far elbow higher than near elbow; far forearm and hand hidden. Opposite arm swing still requires VIDEO verification.

cards.title: Twisting sit-up, opposite elbow/knee
cards.note: Foreground/background leg alternation verified with color bands; cross-body elbow merely nears contact. Original 35 REJECT.

cards.title: Arms-overhead back extension
cards.note: Arms overhead, not out to side; still only.

cards.title: Clap push-up
cards.note: Two hands airborne and clapping, torso lowered compared to earlier version; physical flight still unverified.

cards.title: Semi-spread-eagle jump
cards.note: Airborne spread, hands overhead, return crouch.

cards.title: Pike sit-up
cards.note: Ordinary youth flexibility; fingertips naturally fall short of literal toe contact.

cards.title: Back extension + extra press
cards.note: Both legs raised, pressing movement subtle in stills.

cards.title: Chest-slap push-up
cards.note: Preferred lower unsupported torso; hands touch chest. Video motion and anatomy not certified.

cards.title: Reverse-clasp toe circle
cards.note: Palms-out reverse clasp and circle direction remain unproven.
